name: Build to Survive  [NEW]
desc:
🎮 Build to Survive !

🔥 Build whatever you want and survive the disasters! 🔥 In this game, your creativity is your best weapon. Build structures to protect yourself from catastrophes and show your ingenuity.

💰 Earn money: Survive the disasters to earn money and get accessories!

⚠️ The game is in development: Some bugs may occur. Thank you for your support and understanding.

👍 Like the game to support me and get more updates!
